stage: S2 NCCL baseline; two GPUs only
basis: S1 measured graph broadcast 10.84–10.85 us, P2P false, SHM transport; ranges below are ESTIMATES, not extrapolated model measurements.
expected_gate: NCCL default may miss M0 L<=12 us. Record failure; do one bounded cause/configuration check if needed, then stop/decide. M0 also needs a synthetic chain; passing primitive alone does not clear it.
correctness: Rank-distinct, nonuniform exact BF16 patterns validate the whole output before/after timing. In-place repeated SUM timings use zeros to avoid overflow. For graph128 a single post-timing replay uses rank patterns scaled by 2^-120, whose exact expected final value is pattern*384; no infinities accepted.
one_shot: Unavailable as planned: runtime peer access false. Do not dereference peer pointers, patch drivers, or pretend NCCL-vs-NCCL is a hand-written one-shot comparison. No full S2 pass can be claimed without that comparison.
